sourceEntry: 2026-10-30 — HR phase 3: Leave, income tax, editable deductions, employee contacts
releaseSummary: Finance → Leave with Barbados statutory defaults (all configurable), balances, approvals; unpaid and NIS-paid days come off payroll.
Finance → Income tax: annual tax estimate per employee against PAYE, refund/owed, and unclaimed reliefs with their saving.
Payroll deductions round to the nearest dollar and can be edited on draft payslips; employees link to CRM contacts, and linked contacts can't be deleted; employee notes are editable.

moduleImpact.notes: Updated as part of HR phase 3: Leave, income tax, editable deductions, employee contacts.

migrationNotes: No manual data migration is required for this release.
